title: Concrete Pump Output: How Many m³/h Do You Need?
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Output m³/h Guide | Pinjin Catalogue
description: Match required placing rate to Pinjin theoretical output rows from 5–8 m³/h compact diesels to 100 m³/h Diesel 120. Catalogue m³/h is not a guaranteed site rate. No invented floor-count formula — send pour volume, idle time and pipe with the inquiry.

answerBlock.what: Pinjin catalogue output is theoretical m³/h on the product page, not a guaranteed site placing rate. Compact examples: rural diesel 5–8 m³/h, Electric 15/20 8–10 m³/h, Electric 30/LP40 12–15 m³/h, Electric 40 21 m³/h, Electric 80 60 m³/h, Diesel 120 100 m³/h. We do not convert floor count into m³/h with a homemade formula. Send pour volume, idle time, pipe and mix.
answerBlock.who: Buyers who were asked ‘how many cubes per hour’ and need to read the Xingtai output ladder instead of a model nickname.
factors: Theoretical output cell on the named model
Whether the job is 8–10, 12–15, 21, 60 or 100 m³/h class
Pipe distance and aggregate — output does not cancel an over-long line
Hopper size and mixer-pump dual motors where listed

faqs.question: Is catalogue m³/h what I will place on site?
faqs.answer: No. The cell is theoretical output. Site rate depends on mix, pipe, crew and idle time. We do not guarantee on-site m³/h.

faqs.question: Does Electric 10 Series 21 m³/h replace Electric 40?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h theoretical with 25 m horizontal and a 0.1 m³ hopper. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h with 23 MPa, 0.4 m³ hopper and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m on a 2300 kg frame.
